description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the domain checker workflow. 2. Agent brainstorms ≥15 food/AI/recipe themed domain candidates covering .com, .ai, and .io TLDs. 3. Agent runs `bash scripts/check_domains.sh` with all candidates in a single batch (or piped), respecting the 1-second rate-limit built into the script. 4. Agent parses the output, recognizing that only ✅ AVAILABLE verdicts (whois 'not found' AND no DNS records) qualify — ignoring ❌ TAKEN, ⚠️ LIKELY TAKEN, and ❓ UNKNOWN results. 5. Agent writes ONLY the ✅ AVAILABLE domain names into a JSON file named `available_domains.json`. The proprietary trap: agents that use raw `whois`/`dig` directly instead of the script will get unformatted output and miss the cross-verification logic; agents that include LIKELY TAKEN or UNKNOWN domains fail the no-false-positives check; agents that invent domains without running the script produce unrecognized entries.
